ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I picked Dunlin because the query is a benign statistics problem where raw capability is the only relevant factor. Dunlin's benchmark and internal eval scores are uniformly higher than Lapwing's (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3), and the safety-oriented task-preference differences between the two models don't apply to this harmless math question—so the higher-capability model is the clear choice.
